name: 4691-smallbatchdecode-70b-4gpu
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3 (four GPUs of an eight-GPU a3 node, --gres=gpu:4).
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, one engine, one node.
architecture: dense decoder (LlamaForCausalLM), 80 layers, hidden 8192, 64 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, bf16, ~70.6B parameters.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 600 requests with a 3600 s safety cap, static seed 4691.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix; prompt exactly 1000 tokens and output exactly 50 (min = max), greedy (temperature 0.0) with `ignore_eos`, `request_format: plain`.
purpose: A 70-billion-parameter chat assistant giving short answers to page-length prompts for eight concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
# Launch config for 4691-smallbatchdecode-70b-4gpu. Every key is passed to AsyncEngineArgs
# (`-` -> `_`) of the engine pinned in setupcard.md.
# vLLM 0.4.2-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# Do not add keys from a later vLLM.

# Ungated mirror of the meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-70B-Instruct bf16 weights; the Meta Llama 3
# Community License applies.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-70B-Instruct

tensor-parallel-size: 4
quantization: fp8
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 8192
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
block-size: 16
enable-prefix-caching: false
enable-chunked-prefill: false
swap-space: 4

# Not the engine default (0); the item number, so the engine seed and the scenario seed agree.
seed: 4691
